messages:
Sam V: Heads-up — after today's runtime merge (kernelselect refactor) we're seeing a perf dip on 16x A100 TP+PP jobs when the topology crosses PCIe-only links. Baseline runs on NVLink-only rack: ~36 tok/s; problematic runs: ~28 tok/s. Profiling attached.

Anya P: Can you paste the top-level flame or a small perf snippet? Also CI link?

Sam V: quick profiler dump:
```
# nv-nsight sampling (truncated)
allreduce_total_ms: 42.1 -> 52.6  # +25% when crossing PCIe
kernel: attention_fused_fp16  avg_ms: 9.4
kernel: attention_unfused_fp16 avg_ms: 14.8  # picked on some nodes
memcpy_pcie_ms: 6.0
```
KV cache hit-rate dropped too:
```
kv_cache: hits=8421 misses=3220 hit_rate=0.72  # baseline 0.84
```
Sam V: hypothesis: kernelselect changed heuristic for short seqs -> chooses unfused kernel on some CUDA compute capability combos; combined with cross-node memcpy and less effective batching it's killing overlap.

Jun Lee: +1, saw same pattern. Also noticed continuous batching heuristic slices batches into smaller windows when latency variance high — that increases allreduce frequency.

Mike R: Could be scheduler/reservoir: if we under-batch on PCIe link, allreduce % of step goes up. Can you run microbench:
```
run_microbench --nodes 4 --gpus-per-node 4 --topology pcie-cross --kernelsample on --batch-scan 200
```
and collect `--comm-trace`?

Anya P: Also check KV cache eviction policy during those runs: if prefix reuse falls, we get cache churn. Try `KV_STATS=1` in env.

Sam V: running both now on a replica infra. Will pin to NVLink-only rack and repeat to isolate fabric effect. ETA ~45m.

infra-bot: deploy/runtest-20240315 finished — all tests green :white_check_mark:

Jun Lee: If fabric is root cause we should add a topology-aware kernelselect override: force fused kernels when cross-node latency > X and enable larger batching window to increase compute/comm overlap.

Anya P: Agreed. If experiments confirm, plan: (1) revert heuristic in kernelselect, (2) add runtime flag `--topology-override=fused-prefer` for ops, (3) add gating perf test in CI for TP+PP across PCIe.

Sam V: update — first microbench shows 36.2 tok/s when pinned to NVLink; 27.9 tok/s on PCIe rack. Attaching logs (uploaded to /mnt/artifacts/2012345678/). Will post more when KV stats complete.

Mike R: nice, thanks. After KV stats, let's try `batch-slice=auto` off and `comm-overlap=aggressive` to see if overlap recovers some %. Keep us posted.

Anya P: :eyes:
